pair_sampling: Eight pairs per training batch replace eight positive and eight TTS-negative slots, fixed seed431 pair permutations, same fixed complete windows in both arms. No original source labels are replaced by teacher classes.
advance: Require identical first 16 training batches, pair draw schedule, frozen-head warmups, representative inputs, scalar INT8 export and validation exposure. Treatment must have zero continuous development events, <=1% worst engine/corpus and engine false fraction, and >=3 percentage points macro recall over control. Select control at its best recall in the same strict gate, else a 2% zero-event gate, else its minimum-false zero-event point, preserving prior policy. Only if control has no zero-event grid point, compare with its frozen .97 reference and additionally require treatment worst-group false fraction <=control .97 worst-group fraction. This is a development advancement screen, not Hi ESP parity or firmware approval.
scope: Separately preregistered compact original-intent sequence supervision versus binary-only wake training; development validation only.
hypothesis: Compact two-token CTC can learn the fitted training bank when the encoder trains. Test whether that learnable task improves the actual scalar wake detector against an identically trained binary-only control. Training-bank fit is not the advancement decision.
objective: Original weighted binary BCE remains primary. Both arms use the same118 training pairs and original binary labels. On those paired windows only, a Dense(6) temporal head has the two-token CTC target [hey, original nyx|mix|next|nick synthesis-intent class], normalized by2. No teacher labels or posteriors are used. Both arms share1000 frozen-head updates at.003, then exactly3000 joint updates at binary LR.0002 with the existing.5/.8 schedule; auxiliary gain0 versus.1. Export discards the auxiliary head and retains the existing scalar inference graph. The separately fitted diagnostic encoder/head weights are not imported.
warmup_policy: Binary weights and optimizer must remain unchanged, and complete warmup metadata must match between arms. The new warmup has compact labels rather than the earlier392-phone task; no assertion of replaying that older auxiliary head is made.
limits: Reused development validation and the unchanged21-point threshold grid, with separate negative corpora. Synthesis intent is not human pronunciation truth; the118-pair bank is tiny and correlated. Training fit is not open-set quality. No threshold sweep outside the grid, final/test scoring, speaker playback, microphone recording, firmware/OTA or production-board operation. A pass permits subsequent independent evaluation only; it does not establish real-speaker recall, precise endpoint latency, P4 resources, call stability or Hi ESP parity.
study_boundary: New compact-label joint study after the separately frozen encoder-fit diagnostic passed. No extension or gate change to any rejected frozen-head or weak-phone study. The original full scalar feature cache and all source labels/splits remain unchanged. Keep full immutable executed sources, launch metadata, warmup, final binary/auxiliary checkpoints, model export and development score traces.
